```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)

program <- read_csv("resources/program.csv", col_types = "ccccc") |>
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c(
        "break",
        "keynote",
        "panel",
        "posters",
        "procedural",
        "social",
        "talks",
        "workshop"
      )
    ),
    duration = case_when(
      session == "Pre-conference workshop" ~ "",
      .default = paste0(
        "(",
        time_length(hm(end) - hm(start), unit = "minutes"),
        "min)"
      )
    )
  )

make_program <- function(prog_day) {
  program |>
    filter(date == ymd({{prog_day}})) |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_time(
      columns = c(start, end),
      time_style = "h_m_p"
    ) |>
    cols_label(
      start = "Time",
      session = "Session",
      duration = ""
    ) |>
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(start, session)) |>
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = duration) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(size = px(13)),
      locations = cells_body(columns = duration)
    ) |> 
    cols_hide(c(date, category, end)) |>
    data_color(
      columns = category,
      target_columns = c(session, duration),
      palette = c(
        "#F6C7FF", # break
        "#FFE982", # keynote
        "#FFE982", # panel
        "#FFE982", # posters
        "#FFE982", # procedural
        "#F6C7FF", # social
        "#FFE982", # talks
        "#FFE982" # workshop
      ),
      levels = c(
        "break",
        "keynote",
        "panel",
        "posters",
        "procedural",
        "social",
        "talks",
        "workshop"
      )
    )
}
```
